title: Amy Eskridge's death is the latest to be grouped in a conspiracy abou...
description: Amy Eskridge's death is the latest to be grouped in a conspiracy about missing or dead scientists who had a connection to government research. Eskridge's father, a former NASA employee, says nothing is suspicious about his daughter's suicide in 2022, despite reports that Eskridge had expressed fears her life was in danger at the time. @nancyloonn
